create.name: Kim Chandler
create.bio:
Kim Chandler has run Innerlight Center for Yoga & Meditation on Aquidneck Island in Rhode Island since 1995; the studio began in Newport and now sits in Middletown. Before that she lived as a resident at Kripalu and served as associate director of its yoga teachers' association, and she has now been teaching for over thirty years. Her own practice and teaching rest on classical hatha yoga, breathwork and meditation, including loving-kindness practice, and the studio keeps a donation-based meditation class in the spirit of dana.

Alongside yoga she is a long-standing teacher, and a trainer of facilitators, of Proprioceptive Writing, a contemplative method devised by Linda Trichter Metcalf, with whom she studied closely. The practice uses short timed sessions of writing to music, in which you listen to your thoughts as an inner voice and question them gently. She teaches it at Innerlight, privately by phone and at retreat centres such as Kripalu, often pairing it with gentle yoga. With Janne Roehm she co-directs Innerlight's eleven-month, 200-hour teacher course, and over the years she has trained several hundred yoga teachers.

courses.title: Awaken Inner Clarity: A Guide to Proprioceptive Writing and Yoga
courses.description: A midwinter stay at Kripalu combining gentle yoga with contemplative writing, using the structure of Proprioceptive Writing as a guide. It is meant to renew energy and self-trust after the holidays, and no yoga or writing experience is needed.

courses.title: How to Hear Your Inner Self: A Proprioceptive Writing Immersion
courses.description: Five days at Kripalu with Kim Chandler and fellow Proprioceptive Writing teacher Ann Munroe Mullen. Participants practise the method's three rules in regular 25-minute sittings, learning to listen to their thinking as a voice and to use the writing as a form of meditation.

courses.title: 200 Hour Yoga Immersion & Teacher Course 2027
courses.description: Innerlight's eleven-weekend teacher course, co-directed by Kim Chandler and Janne Roehm and grounded in classical hatha yoga. It covers asana and alignment, pranayama, meditation, philosophy, energetics and teaching method, with practicums and mentoring, and suits both future teachers and those who simply want to study.

courses.title: Loving Kindness Meditation & Gentle Yoga with Guided Relaxation
courses.description: A Saturday afternoon at Innerlight of mindful, gentle yoga, metta meditation and a guided relaxation. The focus is on extending warmth to yourself first and then outwards to others.

courses.title: Innerlight Studio and Zoom Classes
courses.description: The weekly timetable at Innerlight in Middletown, Rhode Island, with yoga and meditation classes in the studio and many also streamed live on Zoom. Classes are bought singly or in passes, and the meditation class is offered on a donation basis.

courses.title: Private Yoga & Proprioceptive Writing Lessons
courses.description: One-to-one or small-group yoga in the studio or at home, and private foundation lessons in Proprioceptive Writing with Kim Chandler, which can also be taken by phone. The writing series focuses on building a steady practice with sound technique.
courses.price: $130 USD per 60-minute private yoga session; writing lessons contact for pricing
